name: Dracula
description: Official Dracula palette anchors plus the derived grayscale ramp used by scripts/gen-themes.mjs to build the DSH token tables. Edit anchors here, then run `npm run generate`.

soft.description: Dracula Soft: a slightly lighter, gentler background variant (official soft background #343746).

grayRamp.description: Anchor stops of the neutral grayscale ramp, lightest (00) to darkest (1000). Steps between anchors are interpolated linearly in sRGB.
